Driver Removal Utility

Uninstall Capto Audio Component

In order to safely remove the CaptoDevice component and its kernel audio routing from your macOS system, please download and run the uninstaller utility.

Download Component UninstallerFile: CaptoUninstaller.zip • Safe, clean removal script

Quick Uninstallation Steps:

1

Download Uninstaller

Click the download button below to fetch the official CaptoUninstaller archive.

2

Extract Package

Unzip the downloaded file from your Downloads folder.

3

Execute & Finish

Run the uninstaller script or utility, grant permission, and your system audio drivers will revert to standard.
